title: BERTSeq2Seq
summary: Builds Transformer-based sequence-to-sequence models initialized from pre-trained BERT, GPT-2, and RoBERTa checkpoints, with released predictions across sentence fusion (DiscoFuse), sentence splitting (WikiSplit), summarization (XSum, CNN/DailyMail, Gigaword), and machine translation; the internal effort applies the recipe to Meridian's text-rewriting features.
